core_research_thesis: Design and development of a high-performance, safe, and efficient battery through the integration of electrochemistry, materials science, electrical engineering, and thermodynamics
proven_facts: The Nernst equation relates the electrode potential to the concentration of reactants and products
The Butler-Volmer equation describes the kinetics of electrochemical reactions
Ohm's Law relates the voltage, current, and resistance of an electrical circuit
Thermodynamic laws govern the behavior of energy and its interactions with matter
critical_unanswered_unknowns: Optimal electrode material composition for high energy density and power density
Effect of electrode surface area and morphology on battery performance
Influence of electrolyte properties on ionic conductivity and battery safety
Impact of battery management system on overall battery performance and lifespan

Electrolyte properties (e.g., ionic conductivity, viscosity, thermal stability)
